items.name: 3 IN 1  AMLA - REETHA - SHIKAKAI POWDER
items.shortDescription: A simple 3-in-1 herbal hair cleansing powder made with Amla, Reetha and Shikakai. A traditional blend that gently cleanses the scalp and hair while leaving hair feeling fresh, clean and naturally conditioned.
items.description:
Experience the simplicity of traditional Indian hair care with our 3 IN 1 Amla–Reetha–Shikakai Powder.

Made with three time-tested Ayurvedic hair-care ingredients — Amla, Reetha and Shikakai — this versatile powder can be used as a natural hair cleanser or as part of your regular hair-care routine.

Reetha naturally contains saponins that help cleanse the scalp and hair, while Shikakai is traditionally used to gently cleanse and condition the hair. Amla adds a nourishing botanical touch to this classic combination.

A minimal-ingredient choice for those who prefer a more traditional, powder-based approach to hair cleansing.
items.howToUse:
As a Hair Cleanser:  
1. Take the required quantity of powder according to your hair length.
2. Add water and mix into a smooth, lump-free paste.
3. Apply to the scalp and hair, gently massage for 1–2 minutes.
4. Leave for 2–3 minutes and rinse thoroughly with water.
5. Repeat if required.

As a Hair Pack:
Mix the powder with water to form a smooth paste. Apply to the scalp and hair, leave for 10–15 minutes, then rinse thoroughly.
